title: Lot Valuator Input
description: Configuration for the Lot Valuator actor

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Maximum number of pending lots to valuate per run (default: 10)

testGeminiComparables.title: Test Gemini comparables only
testGeminiComparables.description: Run the bounded Gemini/eBay comparable test path before normal batch processing. Results are written to the default dataset and OUTPUT; Supabase and OpenAI are not used.

comparableQuery.title: Comparable query
comparableQuery.description: Required when testGeminiComparables is true. Example: Royal Doulton stoneware vase signed 1920s.

comparableLimit.title: Comparable limit
comparableLimit.description: Maximum number of normalized sold and active eBay comparables requested in test mode.
